name: Tre Cime di Lavaredo loop
description: Classic loop around the Tre Cime from Rifugio Auronzo, with the famous north face view near Rifugio Locatelli. Very popular in summer.

name: Lago di Braies lake loop
description: Easy walk around the lake, mostly flat. Good for families and beginners. Very crowded in summer.

name: Lago di Carezza short walk
description: Very short walk around a small lake with the Latemar in the background. Suitable for everyone.

name: Seceda to Col Raiser
description: Take the cable car to Seceda, enjoy the Odle ridge view and walk down through meadows to Col Raiser. Mostly downhill.

name: Lago di Sorapis from Passo Tre Croci
description: Out-and-back trail to a turquoise lake below the Sorapiss. Some short exposed sections with cables, not ideal for people afraid of heights.

name: Cinque Torri loop
description: Short loop around the Cinque Torri towers, with the WWI open-air museum. Reachable by chairlift.

name: Piz Boe from Sass Pordoi
description: From the Sass Pordoi cable car to the 3152 m summit of Piz Boe. High altitude, rocky terrain and some easy scrambling.

name: Via ferrata Brigata Tridentina
description: Popular via ferrata near Passo Gardena, up to Rifugio Pisciadu and down through Val Setus. Requires ferrata equipment and experience.
